offline.held: No network: receiving waits for the network. A receipt, its lots and the hide tags take their numbers from the office. What you entered stays on this screen.
offline.post: No network: a delivery is posted only with the network (the office numbers it). Keep this screen open and post it when the network is back.

noPermission.title: You cannot receive goods here
noPermission.body: Your role at this station does not receive goods. Ask your team leader.

scan.label: Scan the PO or the delivery note
scan.hint: Scan our PO number, on the PO or on the supplier's delivery note, or tap an order below.
scan.ddtKept: Delivery note {code}: it is not one of our PO numbers. Tap the order it brings.

empty.title: Nothing expected
empty.body: Scan the PO number on the delivery note.

scan.pick: Which order does this delivery bring?

lines.refusedShort: This order takes no goods now
lines.refused: This order is {status}: it takes no goods now. Ask the buyer.

ddt.label: Delivery note number
ddt.hint: Scan or type the supplier's delivery note (DDT) number.
ddt.again: Delivery note {code}. Scan again to change it.

lines.title: What we expect

card.noDock: No goods-in dock: ask the office

hold.CR_VI_TEST: waits for its chromium VI result
hold.PPE_CERTIFICATE: PPE part: its certificate is checked
hold.title: Why hold it?

holdBanner.to: Goes to quality hold: put it on {place}. Why: {why}. Only quality releases it.
holdBanner.apart: Goes to quality hold: keep it apart from the stock. Why: {why}. Only quality releases it.

over.now: Over by {quantity}: give the reason when you finish the delivery.
over.ask: Over by {quantity} (at most {upTo} without a reason). Why is it taken?
over.title: Why is more taken?

scan.supplierRead: Tannery number {code}. Scan again to change it.
scan.supplierHint: Scan the tannery's ticket on the hide, or type its number.
scan.otherHint: Scan or type it: it stays for the next hides.

hide.tagsLater: Tags print when you finish the delivery: the office numbers them.

scan.label: Supplier's batch
scan.hint: Scan the supplier's batch barcode, or type it.
scan.read: Supplier's batch {code}. Scan again to change it.

quantity.here: {quantity} on this delivery. Receive again to change it.
quantity.expected: Still to come {open}; at most {upTo} without a reason.
quantity.title: How much came
quantity.label: Quantity

finish.title: Finish the delivery
finish.heldTo_one: {count} lot goes to quality hold: put it on {place}.
finish.heldTo_other: {count} lots go to quality hold: put them on {place}.
finish.heldApart_one: {count} lot goes to quality hold: keep it apart.
finish.heldApart_other: {count} lots go to quality hold: keep them apart.
finish.noDdt: No delivery note number: the office adds it later. Scan it on the lines to add it now.
finish.lineRefused: The office did not accept this line as it was sent. Check it on its step.
finish.noPrinter: No label printer at this station: the tags are not printed here. Ask the office.

note.SHORT: less than expected came: the rest stays expected.
note.WITHIN_TOLERANCE: within the tolerance: the line is received.
note.OVER: more than expected came, with the reason given.
note.HIDE_COUNT: another number of hides than the buyer expected.
note.ONE_DYE_BATCH: more than one dye batch on a line that asks one.
note.THICKNESS: a hide outside the thickness asked.
note.NO_SUPPLIER_DDT: no delivery note number: the office adds it.

tags.noPrinterShort: No label printer at this station
tags.noPrinter: No label printer at this station: the tags are not printed. Ask the office to print them.
tags.failed_one: {count} tag did not print: check the printer, then Retry.
tags.failed_other: {count} tags did not print: check the printer, then Retry.
tags.waiting_one: {count} tag on its way to the printer…
tags.waiting_other: {count} tags on their way to the printer…
tags.allPrinted_one: {count} tag printed: put it on its hide.
tags.allPrinted_other: All {count} tags printed: put each on its hide, in the order you measured them.

scan.label: Scan a tag
scan.hint: Scan a hide tag to see it, or to reprint it.

leave.title: Leave this delivery?
leave.body: What you entered is not posted and goes when you leave.

ORDER_CHANGED.message: The order changed a moment ago
ORDER_CHANGED.fix: It was read again. Check the lines, then finish the delivery again: what you entered is kept.

NOT_RECEIVING.message: This order takes no goods now
NOT_RECEIVING.fix: Ask the buyer which order these goods belong to.

STATUS_DRAFT.fix: Ask the buyer: goods are received against a sent order.

STATUS_CHANGES_PROPOSED.message: The supplier proposed changes to this order
STATUS_CHANGES_PROPOSED.fix: The buyer accepts or refuses them first. Put the goods aside and ask the buyer.

STATUS_RECEIVED.message: This order is received in full
STATUS_RECEIVED.fix: Extra goods need a new order: ask the buyer.

STATUS_CLOSED.fix: Ask the buyer which order these goods belong to.

STATUS_CANCELLED.fix: Put the goods aside and ask the buyer.

STATUS_DECLINED.fix: Put the goods aside and ask the buyer.

NO_DOCK.message: This site has no single goods-in dock
NO_DOCK.fix: The office names the goods-in location. Ask them, then try again.

LINE_REFUSED.message: A line was not accepted as it was sent
LINE_REFUSED.fix: Check the line marked on the summary, then finish the delivery again.

BADGE.message: This badge does not open this tablet
BADGE.fix: The person signed in stays. Ask your team leader.

number.title: The supplier's number
number.hint: Scan its barcode, type it, or use the number pad.

photo.title: Photo of the delivery note
photo.after: The photo goes with the receipt when the delivery is posted.
photo.kept: On this tablet, sent with the receipt

send.sent: Delivery note photo sent with the receipt.
send.failed: The delivery note photo was not sent.
